content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. Before I sign, I would like to request a couple of small adjustments: - Regarding the clause stating "Invoices are payable Net 60. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 1.0% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law.", payment is due 60 days after invoicing, which is longer than the standard 30-day term and creates cash flow delays for you, so I propose changing it to: Invoices are payable Net 30. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 1.0% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law. - Regarding the clause stating "Payment period: Net 60", payment is due within 60 days, which exceeds the standard 30-day window and delays your cash flow, so I propose changing it to: Payment period: Net 30. Thank you for your understanding, and I look forward to moving forward. Best regards.
